messages.content: Evening! What was the headline of your day?
honestly finally fixed my bike. been flat for like 3 weeks
Three weeks! What finally got you to do it?
john was like 'bro just watch a youtube video' so i did and it took 20 mins lol. snapped one tyre lever tho
Classic. Did you get to ride it?
yeah rode to the coffee place near campus, like 3km. felt great ngl
Nice. What else happened today, anything at uni?
had the algorithms lecture, was on dynamic programming, kinda lost me halfway. need to rewatch it. also started this project, an ai diary thing that writes my day as a newspaper
Very meta. How are you feeling about the project?
pretty hyped, wrote the readme and roadmap. bit worried ill get distracted and not finish it like the last one
Fair. How would you rate today out of 10?
like a 7. good day, bit tired
